description:
Fetch one document from a public link (PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD, CSV or HTML, up to 10 MB) and return a draft knowledge base: basic_info, faqs and other_info, like import_knowledge_base does for a website. Nothing is saved: show the draft to the user, then save it with create_knowledge_base. This tool cannot upload files; for a file on disk, use the dashboard or the SDKs. To make a long document searchable during calls instead, use add_knowledge_file.

Requires scope `knowledge_bases:write`.

url.description: A public link to the document, e.g. https://example.com/menu.pdf

name: import_knowledge_file
title: Draft a knowledge base from a document
